card.name: Predicting which patients get tardive dyskinesia
card.fires_on: The word "predict" or the following "which" in the antipsychotic tardive dyskinesia warning, where the text says it is impossible to predict which patients will develop the syndrome.

modes.label: Predict
modes.description: The verb "predict" after "not possible to" or "impossible to" in the tardive dyskinesia warning.
modes.example: but it is not possible to<< predict>> which patients are likely to develop the syndrome

modes.label: Which
modes.description: The word "which" right before "patients are likely to develop the syndrome".
modes.example: it is impossible to rely upon prevalence estimates to predict, at the inception of antipsychotic treatment,<< which>> patients are likely to develop the syndrome.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about which subset of people, such as majority or minority, in the sentence that follows.
card.plain: It fires where the label says doctors cannot tell in advance which patients will develop the movement disorder.
